name: Inline Feedback
description: Semantic in-context outcome message for recoverable failures and completed actions. It owns outcome presentation and announcement behavior while product logic, retry actions, saved/draft truth, and transient toast behavior remain outside the component.

props.name: intent
props.description: Required semantic outcome intent. Error announces a failed outcome; success confirms a completed outcome.

props.name: message
props.description: Required non-empty outcome message. Write outcome, consequence, then next step where useful.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional non-empty title. When omitted, title anatomy is not rendered and Figma showTitle is derived false.

representations.mapsTo: fixed decorative Alert or Check asset selected by intent

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Semantic outcome surface with intent-specific border, surface, text tone, and live-region role.

anatomy.name: intent-icon
anatomy.description: Decorative 20px outcome icon selected by intent and hidden from assistive technology.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Required wrapping body message that may grow to any needed height.

semantics.accessibleName: The visible title and message provide the announced outcome text; the icon is decorative and never contributes an accessible name.
semantics.focus: Inline Feedback never moves focus or introduces a focus target.
requirements: intent=error renders role=alert so a newly inserted failed outcome is announced assertively.
intent=success renders role=status so a newly inserted completed outcome is announced politely.
The component never moves focus when it appears or changes.
The outcome icon is decorative and aria-hidden; meaning remains available in text and is not color-only.
message must be a non-empty string after trimming whitespace.
title is optional; when supplied it must be a non-empty string after trimming whitespace.
Figma showTitle is derived solely from title presence and is not a public prop.
Messages wrap and grow naturally; no fixed two-line height or truncation is imposed.
A retry Button is a sibling owned by the containing pattern and is never embedded by Inline Feedback.
Product or backend logic owns whether the operation actually succeeded and must keep the message consistent with saved data shown elsewhere.
There are no warning, info, loading, dismiss, or toast variants in this API.
